prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished presentation image of TWO final-design concepts for a vertical VK exhibition touchscreen kiosk called Stella. Flat front-on interface artwork, NOT a physical kiosk, no device bezel, no perspective. Two complete 9:16 screens side by side on a light warm-grey editorial board, thin gap, generous margins. High resolution, precise readable Russian typography. Title above board: "Стела · выбор продукта". Small labels under panels: "01 / Спокойный вход" and "02 / Световой портал".
The two supplied logo images are SUPPORTING INSERT ASSETS, NOT edit targets: image1 is official MAX, image2 official VK Видео. Place those exact complete marks as image inserts, preserve proportions, colors, letterforms and clear space. Do NOT redraw, retype, stylize or invent logos. Both logos have equal perceived weight and sit on solid near-black card surfaces. No additional branding.
Both screens preserve actual current copy, exact large white title "Что тебе\nсейчас ближе?" and two large touch choice cards stacked vertically, VK Видео then MAX. On VK card exact subtitle "Видео, которое интересно тебе"; MAX card "Возможности для жизни и бизнеса". These two subtitles are proposed concept copy. Each has a discreet white right arrow, no other body text. Central hierarchy, left-aligned text, broad safe margins, touch controls in middle 35–72% of screen height; bottom quarter mostly ambient background, never put essential actions at bottom.
Left concept: rich nearly-black backdrop, subtle separated blue light upper left and violet lower right, editorial simplicity, quiet high contrast heading, solid dark cards with delicate luminous edge and restrained depth.
Right concept: dark near-black neutral hub with a large abstract clear optical curved portal cropped by outer edge, elegant blue and violet flowing light behind the portal, calm heading area and same two flat dark readable choice cards. Keep brand worlds separate, never pink gradient bridging VK red/blue. VK exact red #FF2B42 blue #0077FF; MAX surrounding light only #00BFFF #6E1AFF #0D001A #471AFF #9500FF white. No particles grid, no pixel vortex, no chromatic aberration, no rainbow outlines, no illustrated people, no microphone, no QR, no sci-fi clutter. Production-level typography and realistic restrained screen glow. Render only specified text, crisp Cyrillic.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity final visual concept board for THREE vertical 9:16 MAX branch screens of a VK exhibition touchscreen Stella. Flat interface artwork, no hardware or perspective. Three complete equally sized screens arranged horizontally on warm light grey neutral board with generous margins, top title "Стела · MAX". Small bottom labels "01 / Вступление", "02 / Выбор", "03 / Миссия". High resolution, crisp Cyrillic.
Supplied image is the official MAX complete logo, a SUPPORTING INSERT. Preserve its exact shape, colors, lettering and proportions; do not recreate or typeset logo. Place it near upper left of each screen within a calm solid #0D001A header area with generous clearspace.
Visual system: MAX project palette exclusively #00BFFF #6E1AFF #0D001A #471AFF #9500FF #FFFFFF, smoothly interpolated. Dark purple cinematic backdrop, broad luminous violet/blue flowing ribbons at outer edges, minimal few fine curved connecting fibers. At most 3 abstract transparent background glass forms, cropped at screen edges; no ring clutter, no galaxy, no pixel mosaic. UI cards are rounded frosted glass: thin bevel, clear refraction at edge, soft matte blur of EVERYTHING behind including fibers, white glyphs/text remain sharp. No dispersion/rainbow edge, thick neon border or highlights behind text. MAX Sans-like rounded humanist typography, white medium/demibold heads, comfortably spaced. Essential actions between 35–73 percent screen height; rest breathing room.

Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished final UI design board for THREE full vertical 9:16 VK Видео branch screens on the Stella exhibition touchscreen. Flat front-on artwork without device, bezel or perspective, three equally sized screens on warm-light-grey presentation board, heading "Стела · VK Видео", labels below "01 / Вступление", "02 / Вопрос", "03 / Результат". High resolution crisp Russian text.
Supplied logo is a SUPPORTING INSERT ASSET, preserve exact complete logo from image without retyping, red front icon, blue left reveal, white wordmark; no deformation, added shadow or effects. Put official logo at upper left of each screen with generous clearspace.
Brand visual language: pure black #000000 background, bold white VK Sans Display-like readable left-aligned headlines, VK Sans Text-like body; red #FF2B42 for solid primary buttons, blue #0077FF for selected indicators, #0040FF only as subtle background glow. Keep red/blue separate, no homemade pink/purple blend. No frosted MAX controls in VK branch. Dramatic restrained blue perimeter light, clean black reading area, firm rounded-rectangle controls, ample spacing. No fake brand frame: instead use allowed blue perimeter glow treatment, do not invent alternative official logo/frame. No mascot, no photos, no voice or QR, no unnecessary badges. Mid-screen interactions, bottom 20% atmosphere.
